title: Invariance of Hurwitz-Stability of Polynomials of Degree Five under Positive Hadamard Powers
summary: A complete characterization of the stability-preserving exponent set for fractional Hadamard powers of a monic Hurwitz-stable polynomial f of degree five is presented. The stability problem is reduced to the analysis of a single scalar function depending only on three parameters formed from the coefficients of the polynomial f. This reduction leads to a unique stability threshold $p_*(f) \in (0,1)$ such that the $p$-th Hadamard power of $f$ is Hurwitz stable if and only if $p > p_*(f)$.
